scope: Local browser verification on the existing seed55 assets. Remote deployment is verified after this local gate; these measurements are not a cold-network or all-device guarantee.

life.performanceScope: Events over 250 ms while a route exists and the world is not paused. Initial preparation and paused frames are separate; a total averaged FPS would mix these phases.

director.absentMacroPolicy: Visible notice, existing stop in same biome, same seed; no invented terrain or regenerated saved populations.

checks.backgroundParity: Original fractional frame inputs and complete native records match; full saved-history checks also run, corrupted stock is rejected, obsolete replies cannot overwrite reset state.

limits: First native region preparation can still take substantial time; UI remains responsive while the worker validates or integrates.
Not a stable 60 FPS or universal 5-second startup claim.
High playback rates and the full director tour need separate performance assessment.
The guide PNG and earlier frozen stage records retain their historical labels.
